description.nature: Ransomware encrypted the appointment-booking database host operated by the Data Processor; an export of appointment records was copied out before encryption.
description.extent: About 38,000 appointment records relating to about 31,500 patients across 12 clinics.
description.location: Data Processor's hosted booking environment (fictional Brightquay Cloud Services).
description.likelyImpact: Exposure of appointment details including reason for visit; booking outage for about 14 hours.

implemented: Affected host isolated by the Data Processor
proposed: Rotate all credentials used by the booking integration
